Barcelona on foot: 6 stops, about 7.0 km. Swipe for what to look for at each one →

1. Park Güell
2. Sagrada Família
3. Casa Milà
4. Casa Batlló
5. Palau de la Música
6. Barcelona Cathedral

📌 Save this for your trip. Which stop would you start with?

Swipe the places you want and Travelhour puts them in walking order. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/travelhour-trip-planner/id6773093615

#barcelonatravel #barcelonaitinerary #walkingtour

Distances are estimates: straight line between stops plus 30% for streets.
